mapper.select: /* SQL ID : OnlnMeetngrmDAO.createZoomCntSelect 설 명 : 생성ZOOM수조회 */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT MEETNGRM.ONLN_MEETNGRM_ID FROM TB_LMS_ONLN_MEETNGRM MEETNGRM JOIN TB_LMS_ONLN_PLTFRM_USER USR ON MEETNGRM.ONLN_PLTFRM_USER_ID = USR.ONLN_PLTFRM_USER_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ONLN_PLTFRM_AUTHRT AUTHRT ON USR.ONLN_PLTFRM_AUTHRT_ID = AUTHRT.ONLN_PLTFRM_AUTHRT_ID WHERE (MEETNGRM.MEETNGRM_SDTTM > TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') OR MEETNGRM.MEETNGRM_EDTTM > TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) AND AUTHRT.ONLN_PLTFRM_STNG_ID = #{onlnPltfrmStngId} )
mapper.delete: /* SQL ID : OnlnMeetngrmDAO.onlnMeetngrmBulkDelete 설 명 : 온라인회의실일괄삭제 */ DELETE FROM TB_LMS_ONLN_MEETNGRM WHERE ONLN_PLTFRM_USER_ID IN ( SELECT USR.ONLN_PLTFRM_USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_ONLN_PLTFRM_USER USR JOIN TB_LMS_ONLN_PLTFRM_AUTHRT AUTHRT ON USR.ONLN_PLTFRM_AUTHRT_ID = AUTHRT.ONLN_PLTFRM_AUTHRT_ID WHERE AUTHRT.ONLN_PLTFRM_STNG_ID = #{onlnPltfrmStngId} )
